title: Approvals
description: Actions with side effects wait for you: a new dataset, changes to a shared one, access to your data. Approve or deny them here or in the chat, or let auto review decide the routine ones. Reading and querying data a socio may use never needs approval.

errors.auto-off: Could not turn auto approvals off.

toasts.auto-off: Auto approvals are off for this socio.

waiting.title: Waiting for you
waiting.count_one: {{count, number}} request. Nothing happens until you decide; requests expire after a week.
waiting.count_other: {{count, number}} requests. Nothing happens until you decide; requests expire after a week.

policies.title: Policies
policies.description: Per socio and per capability: Manual asks you every time; Auto lets a decision model on your inference decide in your place, and it passes anything unclear or above the capability’s risk limit to you; Bypass lets the socio go ahead. Quotas and the audit apply either way, and every change of policy is recorded.
policies.auto-on: Auto approvals are on for {{socio}}: {{capabilities, list(type: unit; style: short)}}. A decision model decides these in your place; what it is unsure about still comes to you, and every decision is listed below with its reason.
policies.limits: Approved automatically up to {{risk}} risk; anything riskier comes to you.
policies.no-undo: Automatic approvals can’t be undone here.

guidance.title: Guidance for auto approvals
guidance.description: Optional. A few lines the decision model reads with every request it decides for you, e.g. “Datasets for my budget are fine; never give a socio write access to shared data.” It applies to all your socios. Leave out passwords and other secrets.
guidance.label: Guidance for auto approvals

audit.title: Audit
audit.description: Every request, decision and policy change.

events.auto_escalated: Passed to you by auto review
